title: Missing Project Element
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Find the one essential project element that each of six fictional project descriptions lacks.

learningObjectives: The learner will attribute the weakness of each of six project descriptions to the one essential element it lacks, correctly attributing at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The seven essential elements of a project, the driving question, and the public exhibition, from the section "Projects" in Chapter 14.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: Students build a model to a teacher's exact plans and show it at a fair. Which element is missing?
A project uses invented numbers from a worksheet but is otherwise strong. Which element is missing?
commonMisconceptions: A project that produces something is a good project
A hands-on activity has every element
assessmentOpportunities: Students build a model to a teacher's exact plans and show it at a fair. Which element is missing?
A project uses invented numbers from a worksheet but is otherwise strong. Which element is missing?
Does producing a product make a project a good project?
Students present to the city council but never discuss what they learned. What is missing?

controls.name: 6 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the elements; two tries per project.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the elements and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
